    if len(set(b)) == 1:
        return 1
    
    # Try deleting each element and check if the remaining sequence is arithmetic
    for i in range(n):
        temp_b = b[:i] + b[i+1:]
        diff = [temp_b[j] - temp_b[j-1] for j in range(1, len(temp_b))]
        if len(set(diff)) == 1:
            return i + 1
    
    # If no such index is found
    return -1

        if len(arr) < 2:
            return True
        diff = arr[1] - arr[0]

            if arr[i] - arr[i - 1] != diff:
                return False
        return True

            return j + 1
    
    return -1

def find_index_to_delete(n, b):
    from collections import Counter
    
    # Count occurrences of each element
    count = Counter(b)
    
    # Remove duplicates to focus on unique elements
    unique_elements = list(count.keys())
    
    # Check if removing any element results in an arithmetic progression
    for i in range(len(unique_elements)):
        element_to_remove = unique_elements[i]
        reduced_sequence = [x for x in b if x != element_to_remove]
        
        # Sort the reduced sequence to check for arithmetic progression
        sorted_sequence = sorted(reduced_sequence)
        
        # Calculate common difference if it exists
        if len(sorted_sequence) == 1:
            continue
        
        diff = sorted_sequence[1] - sorted_sequence[0]
        
        # Check if all differences are equal
        if all(sorted_sequence[j] - sorted_sequence[j-1] == diff for j in range(2, len(sorted_sequence))):
            return b.index(element_to_remove) + 1
    
    return -1

def find_arithmetic_progression_index(n, b):
    from collections import Counter
    
    # Count occurrences of each number in the sequence
    count = Counter(b)
    
    # Function to check if a list forms an arithmetic progression
    def is_arithmetic(lst):
        if len(lst) <= 1:
            return True
        lst.sort()
        diff = lst[1] - lst[0]
        for i in range(2, len(lst)):
            if lst[i] - lst[i-1] != diff:
                return False
        return True
    
    # Try deleting each element and checking if the remaining form an arithmetic progression
    for j in range(n):
        remaining = [x for i, x in enumerate(b) if i != j]
        if is_arithmetic(remaining):
            return j + 1
    
    return -1
